start.title: [TODO:it] The Voice from Above
start.text:
[TODO:it] A voice fills the sky.
"Noah — build an ark. A flood is coming."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:it] Genesis 6:22 — Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
[TODO:it] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: [TODO:it] Voices of the Crowd
mockery.text:
[TODO:it] Villagers gather, laughing.
"A boat? Here? You are mad, old man."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:it] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah kept building the ark, despite the world's mockery.
[TODO:it] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: [TODO:it] Cypress and Pitch
building.text:
[TODO:it] Years of sweat. Wood splits. Pitch seals.
Your back aches, but the ark rises.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:it] Genesis 6:14-16 — Noah built the ark of cypress wood exactly as God instructed.

ark_done.title: [TODO:it] It Stands Finished
ark_done.text:
[TODO:it] The ark towers above you.
Your family gathers, silent before the wood.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 6:9 — Noah walked with God and gave Him thanks for every step.

animals.title: [TODO:it] Two by Two
animals.text:
[TODO:it] Creatures come from every land.
Lions beside lambs. Eagles at your feet.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:it] Genesis 7:8-9 — The animals came to Noah two by two, and he received them.

boarding.title: [TODO:it] The Door Closes
boarding.text:
[TODO:it] Your family is inside. The animals settle.
God Himself shuts the door.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:16 — The Lord Himself shut the door of the ark behind Noah.

storm.title: [TODO:it] The Heavens Open
storm.text:
[TODO:it] Rain crashes like nothing seen before.
The deep bursts. The world drowns.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:23 — Noah trusted God as the flood covered the earth.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: [TODO:it] Forty Days
inside.text:
[TODO:it] The ark rocks. The animals breathe.
Days blur. Only the creak of wood remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:24 — Noah cared for his family and the animals through 150 days on the waters.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: [TODO:it] The Dove Returns
dove.text:
[TODO:it] You release a dove. Hours pass.
It comes back — an olive leaf in its beak.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:it] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned with an olive leaf — a sign of new life.

dry_land.title: [TODO:it] Earth Beneath Your Feet
dry_land.text:
[TODO:it] The door opens. Sun spills in.
You step onto warm, living mud.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 8:20 — Noah's first act on dry land was to build an altar to the Lord.

covenant.title: [TODO:it] The Rainbow
covenant.text:
[TODO:it] A rainbow arcs across the sky.
"Never again. This is my covenant with you."
